cover.title: Your Debt Can Double in 3 Years
cover.label: APR 24%

lines.text: There's a 10-second trick to see how fast money doubles. It's called the Rule of 72.
Take 72 and divide it by the interest rate. That's roughly how many years it takes to double.
Invest at 8% a year, and your money doubles in about 9 years.
lines.say: Invest at eight percent a year, and your money doubles in about nine years.

lines.text: But it works on debt too. A credit card at 24% APR doubles what you owe in about 3 years, if you don't pay it down.
lines.say: But it works on debt too. A credit card at twenty-four percent A P R doubles what you owe in about three years, if you don't pay it down.

lines.text: So the same math that makes you rich can also bury you.
Three ways to use it. Check the rate on every debt you have.
Pay off the highest rate first.
And give your investments time to double, then double again. It's an estimate, not a promise.
That's the money. Follow for more.
